title: David McAllister
gist: A Prospect contributor index page for David McAllister, production and associate editor and the magazine's art critic, listing 95 pieces whose recent run is dominated by visual art (Anish Kapoor, Richard Dadd, Ryan Gander), obituaries and internet-culture criticism.

insights.claim: Prospect's art criticism is written in-house by its production and associate editor rather than an external critic, with 95 published pieces attributed to him.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Tells you where UK long-form art coverage is being produced and who to track for gallery and market commentary.
insights.quote: David McAllister is production & associate editor, and Prospect’s art critic

insights.claim: The critic's most recent output clusters on major living-artist profiles and retrospectives — Anish Kapoor, Richard Dadd, Ryan Gander and Gilberto Gil — alongside obituaries including one for David Hockney.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: A read on which artists and estates are getting sustained UK critical attention, which tends to track institutional and market interest.
insights.locator: The cosmic paradox of Anish Kapoor

insights.claim: The same byline covers internet-native culture (The Backrooms and the horrors of the internet) and Venice Biennale politics including Russia's return to Venice, indicating Prospect treats online subculture and art-world geopolitics as one beat.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Signals where cultural-politics friction is expected next: national pavilions and platform-native culture.
insights.locator: The Backrooms and the horrors of the internet
